text:
Iron(II) chloride solution reacts with chlorine gas.
The equation is shown.
2FeCl2(aq)  +  Cl2(g)  →  2FeCl3(aq)
Which statements about this reaction are correct?
Fe2+ ions are reduced to Fe3+ ions.
1
2
Chlorine acts as a reducing agent.
Fe2+ ions each lose an electron.
3
Cl2 molecules are reduced to Cl– ions.
4
A
1 and 2
B
2 and 3
C
2 and 4
D
3 and 4
subject: Chemistry
